text_block_list.text:
A few days after Fuji Kiseki saved me by
finding my badge, I see her
speaking with
a younger student near the school gates.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see. So that's what is troubling you.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text:
Right... I've always wanted to be like my
sister and race in the Twinkle
Series, but
there's no way with my run record.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text:
You know, when she was my age, she was
already race-ready. I just
don't have any
talent, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Alas, the sword is heavy in hand, and the
path of thorns cuts deep. I
fear I cannot go
on."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The valiant heroes who saved the people
once held firm their swords
of deliverance,
and cut a path forward through this hill of
piercing
thorns."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"But I... I cannot. And I could never. Such
burden, such pain... I, who
cannot bear it,
have not the right to be called a hero."

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text: Uh, Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Overcome with despair, she falls to the
ground. But then a girl
appears who had
been watching over her since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The girl speaks to the woebegone hero.
"So long as you do not let
go, the right to
be a hero will ever be in your hands."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Never forget, your will is yours forever.
You needn't hold a sword,
nor run through
ripping thorns. You will always have your
own path to
follow."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The hero then casts her sword and armor
aside, and with naught but
her own self,
she ascends the hill of thorns. With her
honed fist, she
vanquishes the evil and
saves the kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trust in all your years of training, and
believe in your own will...
Okay?

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text: My training and my will...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Blame not your differences with your
sister. Instead, try to look
within.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is a path out there—one which can
be traversed by you alone!

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text: Fuji!

Overcome with emotion, the young runner
begins to cry, but finds
comfort in Fuji
Kiseki's kind touch. Finally, she departs
with a look of
relief on her face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? Could it be? The trainer from before!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So you saw all that. I'd like to keep private
matters private. You
mustn't tell anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You really think she feels better? Well, if
a passing trainer thinks so, I
suppose it
must be true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know it's hard to keep a smile on your
face all the time... But I want
to at least
make the little ones happy when I'm
around.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My own words lack the same poignancy, so
I quoted something from
when I saw my
mother onstage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be glad if it lightened the weight on
her heart, even if only a little.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That she is! And quite a famous one in
those circles.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her performances are nothing short of
legendary! When she appears
onstage,
one mere utterance rivets the entire
audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And at each play's end, the theater
rumbles with thunderous
applause! You
can imagine the joy on each person's face!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My mother is the greatest entertainer I've
ever known!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Correct you are. Admiring my mother
onstage was the start of it. I
even thought
to follow in her footsteps onto the big
stage at first.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But as you can see... it wasn't meant to be.
I was heartbroken, facing
the chasm
between who I wanted to be... and reality.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's when my mother quoted those lines
to me. And she said,
"There's more than
one path. Learn to expand your horizons."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So after searching and searching for a new
path to follow, I finally
found it... racing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I first set foot on the turf, I...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. It's come time for me to
race in a scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it pleases you, you must come to watch
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, I go to see Fuji Kiseki's race.
There, I become truly
captivated...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
S-such beautiful running! Look at that
polished form, that elegant
movement...
I'm totally enchanted!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: And the way she accelerates is amazing! Just how fast can she go?! This is so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a miracle of a performance that
will make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For I... am the miracle of the turf, Fuji
Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard such a surge of applause
at a scrimmage! This shows
how captivating
she really is!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki, that was an incredible race! I
would love to talk to you
about becoming
your trainer!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: That goes for me too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, hearing such words brings me
great joy! But you must forgive
me.
Unfortunately, I'm not accepting any offers
at this time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First, you see, I must prove to every trainer
at the tryouts that I have
what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So you would like to give everyone a fair
shot at seeing what kind of
racer you
really are... All right, I'll look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, one and all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So long as there are people hoping for a
miraculous race, it is this
entertainer's
mission to give them a show to remember.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I invite you to enjoy the tryouts to your
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's remarks have a dignity and
strength that convey her
readiness for
anything that comes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter the stage, I shall entertain one
and all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, no matter the stage...
